inputs update:
NAME
    update - Update flake inputs in flake.lock

SYNOPSIS

    confctl [global options] inputs update [command options] [input-name ...]

COMMAND OPTIONS
    --[no-]all           - Update all root inputs (dangerous; normally specify
                           names)
    --[no-]changelog     - Include git log in the commit message (default:
                           enabled)
    --[no-]commit        - Commit changes to git
    -d, --[no-]downgrade - Treat change as downgrade for changelog direction
    --[no-]editor        - Open $EDITOR with commit message (default: enabled)
ssh:
NAME
    ssh - Run command over SSH

SYNOPSIS

    confctl [global options] ssh [command options] [machine-pattern [command [arguments...]]]

COMMAND OPTIONS
    -a, --attr=arg         - Filter by attribute (may be used more than once,
                             default: none)
    -f, --input-file=arg   - File passed to standard input (default: none)
    -g, --[no-]aggregate   - Aggregate identical command output
    -i, --input-string=arg - Data passed to standard input (default: none)
    --managed=arg          - Filter (un)managed machines (default: none)
    -p, --[no-]parallel    - Run command in parallel on all machines at once
    -t, --tag=arg          - Filter by tag (may be used more than once, default:
                             none)
    -y, --[no-]yes         - Assume the answer to confirmations is yes
generation rotate:
NAME
    rotate - Auto-remove old machine generations

SYNOPSIS

    confctl [global options] generation rotate [command options] [machine-pattern]

COMMAND OPTIONS
    -a, --attr=arg                    - Filter by attribute (may be used more
                                        than once, default: none)
    --[no-]gc, --[no-]collect-garbage - Do not run the garbage collector if
                                        enabled in configuration (default:
                                        enabled)
    -l, --[no-]local                  - List local build generations
    --max-concurrent-gc=n             - Max number of concurrent
                                        nix-collect-garbage processes (default:
                                        5)
    -r, --[no-]remote                 - List remote machine generations
    -t, --tag=arg                     - Filter by tag (may be used more than
                                        once, default: none)
    -y, --[no-]yes                    - Assume the answer to confirmations is
                                        yes

deploy:
NAME
    deploy - Deploy target systems

SYNOPSIS

    confctl [global options] deploy [command options] [machine-pattern [switch-action]]

COMMAND OPTIONS
    -a, --attr=arg            - Filter by attribute (may be used more than once,
                                default: none)
    --copy-only               - Do not activate copied closures
    --cores=number            - Number of CPU cores to be used (see nix build)
                                (default: none)
    --disable-auto-rollback   - Disable auto-rollback
    --[no-]dry-activate-first - Try to dry-activate before the real switch
    --enable-auto-rollback    - Enable auto-rollback
    -g, --generation=arg      - Deploy selected generation (default: none)
    --[no-]health-checks      - Toggle health checks (default: enabled)
    -i, --[no-]interactive    - Ask for confirmation before activation
    -j, --max-jobs=number     - Maximum number of build jobs (see nix build)
                                (default: none)
    --[no-]keep-going         - Do not abourt on failed health checks
    --max-concurrent-copy=n   - Max number of concurrent nix-copy-closure
                                processes (default: 5)
    --[no-]one-by-one         - Copy and deploy machines one by one
    --[no-]reboot             - Reboot target systems after deployment
    --[no-]show-trace         - Enable traces in Nix
    -t, --tag=arg             - Filter by tag (may be used more than once,
                                default: none)
    --wait-online=arg         - Wait for the machine to boot (default: 600)
    -y, --[no-]yes            - Assume the answer to confirmations is yes
